theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the rank-1 eligible theme with the highest durability bar (0.59) and positive breadth (0.538), suggesting the leadership is reasonably cohesive rather than a single-name squeeze. While the Hurst tag is mean-revert and cross-sectional momentum is not alpha, the absolute-trend gate (the only validated leg) keeps it as one of just 4 eligible themes, and crowding is mild (z=0.64, not crowded). This leans with the current leadership rather than predicting a continuation.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert, so the trend is fragile by construction; a mean-reverting leader can snap back quickly, and the breadth of rotation is narrow (0.24) meaning the whole tape is not confirming leadership.
